title: parallax_engine/subagents.py — AgentDefinitions for all five subagents (stub prompts)
implementation_notes: AgentDefinition is a frozen dataclass with name, model, description, allowed_tools (tuple), system_prompt
__post_init__ enforces no 'Agent' tool in allowed_tools (raises ValueError if present, per §9.6)
Five definitions: SCENE_DESIGNER (sonnet), ASSET_GENERATOR (haiku), MASK_AUTHOR (haiku), CAMERA_PATHER (sonnet), QA_CRITIC (sonnet)
Tool lists match §3.3 table exactly; stub prompts include canned status strings matching §3.3 return contract
ALL_SUBAGENTS tuple + SUBAGENT_BY_NAME dict provide ordered iteration and fast name lookup
Uses stdlib dataclasses only — no new dependencies, licensing clean
